ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of every director, officer, shareholder, resident agent, and UBO against the Panama Financial Intelligence Unit (UAF) sanctions list, the U.S. OFAC SDN List, United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, and the European Union consolidated sanctions list. Enhanced due diligence is required for any Politically Exposed Person (PEP), including foreign PEPs, domestic PEPs, and family members or close associates. Screening must be applied at onboarding, prior to incorporation, and on an ongoing risk-sensitive basis at least annually or upon any beneficial ownership change.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá — Sistema de Servicios Electrónicos (eST@r) at https://estar.registropublico.gob.pa
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The official corporate name may be in Spanish or a foreign language, provided it uses Latin script. All corporate names must end with 'S.A.', 'Sociedad Anónima', or an equivalent abbreviation accepted by the Registrar when necessary for the particular corporate form. Foreign-language names must be accompanied by a Spanish transliteration where the Registrar determines that pronunciation or direct transcription is ambiguous. The name must be distinguishable from all existing registrations in the Public Commercial Register.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the chosen corporate name is rejected or challenged, the applicant or registered agent shall file a written 'Recurso de Apelación' with the Director General of the Registro Público de Panamá within five business days of the rejection notice, identifying the proposed name, the registry rejection reference, and the legal basis for distinctiveness. The Director General must issue a resolution within ten business days. If the rejection is upheld, the applicant may request a name modification through the eST@r portal, or file a judicial review action before the Sala Tercera de lo Contencioso-Administrativo of the Corte Suprema de Justicia within two months of the notification of the administrative decision.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is not permissible as the sole physical operating address for the company; however, a registered office consisting of the resident agent's physical office in Panama is acceptable for statutory registration and correspondence. The company must separately maintain a physical commercial address, if it engages in local operations, or rely on the resident agent's office for service of process and AML/CFT compliance correspondence. Low-risk novelty distribution through platforms may lawfully maintain only a registered agent address provided no physical warehouse or staff is stationed in Panama.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low for the first 12 months, quantified at 10% to 15%, absent banking triggers, tax registration inconsistencies, or independent financial audit requirements; the risk rises to approximately 20% if the company applies for a local bank account or registers as an importer with the Panama Customs Authority.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 32 de 1927 (Panama Companies Law), as amended by Ley 5 de 2018; Articles 2, 5, 6, 10, 30, 56 and 66.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección de Mercantil (Public Registry of Panama, Mercantile Section)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución de Sociedad Anónima (Public Deed of Incorporation)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; an S.A. may be incorporated with as little as one share. No escrow account deposit is required; capital contributions may be payable in installments as agreed in the by-laws.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION OF THE INCORPORATING BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF [COMPANY NAME], Panama. The incorporators and undersigned directors hereby resolve: (1) The shares of the corporation, previously subscribed in the Public Deed, are ratified and accepted as fully valid; any unpaid subscription installments shall be payable on demand of the Board. (2) The registered office of the corporation is fixed at [Address], Corregimiento de Bella Vista, Distrito de Panamá, Republic of Panama, and the resident agent is appointed accordingly. (3) [Name] is appointed President and Chief Executive Officer, [Name] is appointed Secretary, and [Name] is appointed Treasurer, each to hold office until the next general shareholders' meeting. (4) The officers are authorized to execute all registration filings.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarize the Public Deed of Incorporation (Escritura Pública)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública del Circuito de Panamá
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a licensed Panama attorney to draft the Escritura Pública. Present the corporate name reservation certificate and the subscribers' identification to the notary, then execute the deed before the notary. The notary will prepare certified copies for filing.
required_dossiers: Certificate of name reservation issued by Registro Público
Passport or CI of each subscriber/director
Registered office consent letter or lease
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary observes legal deficiencies, amend the draft and execute the deed on the same day; no registry penalty is incurred if corrected prior to presentation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Inscribe the Corporation at the Public Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección de Mercantil (virtual or physical window)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notarized Escritura Pública together with the Registry duplicate, pay the inscription tariff, and request entry in the Mercantile Register. Verify the assigned folio and legal status certification.
required_dossiers: Proof of payment of registration fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry returns a 'gravamen' note, respond within 10 business days through the licensed agent with corrective documentation; the original inscription date is retained once cured.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Tax Identification Number (RUC) from the DGI
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After inscription, submit the registry certificate and completed RUC application form to the DGI portal or window. Register the corporation's tax domicile and select the territorial income tax regime.
required_dossiers: Identity card of resident agent or legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DGI requests additional evidence, present it within 5 business days; the RUC is issued once the observation is satisfied.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File Municipal Aviso de Operación and Patente Municipal
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipalidad de Panamá, Dirección de Rentas y Patentes
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Aviso de Operación stating the industrial activity (manufacture of silicone tactile articles). Pay the minimum patent fee based on declared paid-up capital and obtain the stamped patente. Display the municipal license at the physical plant.
required_dossiers: Rental contract or certificate of address
Copy of public deed and ID of legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a defect is found, pay the corresponding annual patent fee and re-file within 10 working days; operating without the aviso is subject to closure, so cure promptly.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Legalize Corporate Books (Share Ledger and Minutes Book)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) – Corporate Book Legalization Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the share ledger (Libro de Acciones), Board and Shareholders Minutes Book (Libro de Actas), and accounting records. Submit the unbound books to the DGI legalization office to be stamped and foliated. Maintain the legalized books at the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the books show omissions, correct and rebind through a certified accountant and resubmit for legalization; each book must be stamped before first use to be admissible in evidence.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI) and Municipalidad de Panamá
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Patente Municipal de Industria y Comercio with Aviso de Operación

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE), Dirección de Evaluación de Impacto Ambiental
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Categoría I – Registro Ambiental; small-scale silicone molding and assembly does not require a full EIA report unless production capacity or discharge thresholds are exceeded.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge limits per Resolución AG-0157-2002; air emission standards per Executive Decree No. 106 of 2000; VOC control per national air quality regulation; hazardous waste handling per Law 21 of 1994 and its implementing regulations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá fire-safety inspection certificate; Dirección Regional de Ingeniería Municipal structural load inspection; MINSA occupational health clearance for the physical workplace.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) del Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas de la República de Panamá; electronic portal: Sede Electrónica (T@PA) at https://sede.dgi.gob.pa
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity establishing a Panamanian Sociedad Anónima must: (1) file Articles of Incorporation with the Public Registry of Panama; (2) obtain a corporate taxpayer identification number (RUC) through the DGI's Sede Electrónica by submitting the corporate affidavit, Public Registry file number, and legal representative details; (3) obtain a municipal operating notice (Aviso de Operación) from the relevant municipality; (4) the same RUC is used for ITBMS registration, automatically designating the entity as a VAT collector; (5) obtain a digital certificate for T@PA electronic filing.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Panama does not provide a U.S.-style check-the-box election. The S.A. is an entity-level taxpayer subject to Panama's territorial income tax, with no pass-through election. Available statutory elections include the simplified Small Taxpayer Regime under Article 711 of the Fiscal Code for qualifying annual gross income up to B/.36,000, and accelerated depreciation or special ITBMS rate elections for certain sectors. No hybrid mismatch elections are available for domestic S.A. entities.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (ITBMS - Impuesto a la Transferencia de Bienes Materiales y Servicios)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general turnover threshold for ITBMS registration; every person/company transferring goods or rendering services in Panama must register for ITBMS and obtain a RUC. A simplified compliance regime (Small Taxpayer Regime) is available for annual gross income up to B/.36,000, which conditions the duty to issue pre-printed invoices but does not eliminate the ITBMS obligation.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Panama has phased mandatory electronic invoicing through the DGI's 'Facturación Electrónica' system (T@PA). Large taxpayers must transmit invoices in near real time via API/web services to DGI for validation, with each invoice assigned a fiscal QR code and digital stamp. Smaller taxpayers may continue using approved printed or computer-generated invoices subject to phased onboarding into the e-invoicing mandate. No separate customs clearance of invoices is required.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of tangible goods, including silicone fidget toys, qualify for zero-rated ITBMS when legal title and possession pass to a non-resident buyer and the goods leave Panamanian territory in accordance with customs procedures, with evidence of physical exit and completion of sale within six months. Services supplied for use solely abroad to a non-resident beneficiary are also zero-rated if not consumed within Panama. The exporter must include the transaction in periodic ITBMS returns and retain supporting documentation.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Formulario Único de Aduanas (Customs Export Declaration / DUA)
Bill of Lading (ocean) or Air Waybill (air)
Inward Remittance Certificate / SWIFT credit confirmation of foreign payment
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The DGI may audit export evidence within the four-year statute of limitations, extended to six years for fraud. A fraudulent zero-rating claim triggers retroactive assessment of full ITBMS, monthly interest at 1.25%, and penalties up to 200% of the evaded tax for deliberate fraud. Criminal liability for tax evasion can result in imprisonment. Registration suspension and loss of input VAT credit entitlement also apply.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco Nacional de Panama (National Bank of Panama) acting as fiscal agent of the Republic; monetary and banking supervision rests with the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panama (SBP). Panama has no autonomous central bank and does not issue domestic fiat currency; the United States Dollar is the legal tender by constitutional and treaty mandate, and the nominal national unit (Balboa) is merely a bookkeeping equivalent at parity.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full de jure and de facto convertibility under a fully dollarized monetary system. There are no exchange controls, no capital account restrictions, and no administrative approval requirements for current account or capital account flows. Profit remittances to non-resident shareholders are freely executable through the banking system under Panama's territorial tax regime; the S.A. is not subject to Panamanian income tax on foreign-source manufacturing profits, and no Panamanian withholding tax applies to dividend distributions. Bank-level anti-money-laundering verification and corporate good standing remain the only practical hurdles.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Panama imposes no statutory surrender obligation, no minimum conversion ratio, and no repatriation timeline for export receipts, because USD is domestic legal tender. Export proceeds from silicone stress relief fidget toys may be retained onshore or offshore at the exporter's discretion; however, the bank will require a coherent export file comprising commercial invoices, packing lists, transport documents, and Panama customs export declarations to support the economic substance and tax-territoriality position.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and Operational Account
Operational Account and Capital Escrow Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: BAC International Bank Inc., Panama Branch

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium feasibility with licensing limitation. Panama does not maintain an EU-style Electronic Money Institution (EMI) licensing passport; unlicensed foreign EMIs cannot originate deposit-taking or account-maintenance activities locally. Nevertheless, cross-border fintech platforms (PayPal, Stripe, Amazon settlement aggregators, Airwallex) remain viable as pure payment gateways for e-commerce receipts, provided that funds are swept downstream to a licensed Panama S.A. bank account and no local Panamanian account is represented. An optional SBP Innovation Hub fintech sandbox arrangement exists, but is unnecessary for this low-risk, standard manufacturing entity.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is generally mandatory for at least one Director and the final beneficial owner at tier-1 Panamanian banks during the initial underwriting interview for a newly incorporated non-resident-owned S.A. Remote opening is permitted under a discretionary risk-based policy at selected banks, subject to a live video-call interview, apostilled notarized board resolutions, a certified Registro Publico company extract, a sworn source-of-funds declaration, and a letter executed before a Panamanian notary or the licensed Resident Agent.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Panamanian S.A. with historical bearer-share association and a fully foreign ownership chain, producing an opacity flag in automated risk scoring.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified legal existence certificate from the Registro Publico de Panama; notarized and apostilled shareholder ledger and transfer records; Panama Beneficial Ownership Registry filing receipt (Ficha de Beneficiario Final under Ley 23 de 2015); full corporate organization chart; valid passports of directors and shareholders; sworn affidavit of economic substance; recommendation letter from a licensed Resident Agent.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity silent settlement flows from international e-commerce platforms without a physical point-of-sale footprint, resembling layering patterns.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed supply and distribution agreements; platform merchant settlement reports; sample platform payout notifications; matched supplier invoices and purchase orders; customs export declarations for goods leaving Panama; warehouse or third-party fulfillment-operator contracts; reconciled commercial bank statements for the last 12 months where available.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial owner or signatory appearing on negative-media, sanctions, or PEP-related screening lists.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent negative-media and watchlist screening report from a recognized provider (World-Check or LexisNexis); certified passport and proof of residential address; notarized source-of-wealth and source-of-funds statements; comprehensive corporate and personal reference letters; where a PEP match exists — an approved Enhanced Due Diligence file and compliance committee sign-off from the correspondent bank.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant wire protocol: inbound share-capital contribution is routed via SWIFT MT103 in USD from the non-resident shareholder's bank to the Panama S.A. operational or capital escrow account, clearing through the US correspondent banking network (CHIPS/Fedwire). The remittance instruction must clearly state 'Capital Contribution / Aporte de Capital' and is accompanied by the notarized and apostilled board resolution authorizing the subscription or increase of capital, an updated shareholder registry, a certificate of good standing, and the transferring bank's source-of-funds documentation. No central-bank approval or pre-notification is required because Panama maintains no exchange-control regime.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements for raw materials (food-grade silicone, molds, packaging) are executed via: (i) SWIFT MT103 telegraphic transfers for direct supplier payments; (ii) irrevocable commercial letters of credit issued through SWIFT MT700 instruments for documentary trade with Asian or regional counterparties; (iii) local ACH Panama (Camara de Compensacion) clearing for domestic USD payments; and (iv) Fedwire/CHIPS via US correspondents for high-value USD disbursements. Each outbound transfer must be supported by a supplier proforma or final invoice, shipping or customs evidence, and beneficiary KYC information to satisfy SBP Circular AML compliance expectations.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright deliverable foreign-exchange forwards (USD/EUR, USD/CNH) traded OTC with an SBP-licensed Panama bank under ISDA documentation.
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referenced to USD for exposures in restricted or lightly convertible currencies (e.g., CNH/CNY), executed through an international dealer arranged by the Panama bank.
Cross-currency swaps matching USD-denominated receipts against EUR or CNH input-cost obligations, subject to board treasury mandate and SBP derivative eligibility.
Vanilla FX swaps (spot plus forward roll) permitting temporary liquidity re-denomination without creating speculative open currency positions.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory tax holiday applies to a Panama S.A. engaged in ISIC 3240 compression molding of silicone fidgets. Panama's territorial tax system excludes qualifying foreign-source income from the taxable base. The preferential effective rate for small taxpayers with gross income not exceeding B/.150,000 is 15% under the simplified regime. The 4% advance dividend tax is creditable against the annual corporate income tax. Loss carryforward relief is available for 5 consecutive fiscal years.
